options.name: backups_enabled
options.description: Optional, Boolean, enables backups for your droplet.

options.name: command
options.description: Which target you want to operate on.

options.name: id
options.description: Numeric, the droplet id you want to operate on.

options.name: image_id
options.description: This is the slug of the image you would like the droplet created with.

options.name: ipv6
options.description: Optional, Boolean, enable IPv6 for your droplet.

options.name: name
options.description: String, this is the name of the droplet - must be formatted by hostname rules, or the name of a SSH key.

options.name: private_networking
options.description: Bool, add an additional, private network interface to droplet for inter-droplet communication.

options.name: region_id
options.description: This is the slug of the region you would like your server to be created in.

options.name: size_id
options.description: This is the slug of the size you would like the droplet created with.

options.name: ssh_key_ids
options.description: Optional, array of SSH key (numeric) ID that you would like to be added to the server.

options.name: ssh_pub_key
options.description: The public SSH key you want to add to your account.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the target.

options.name: unique_name
options.description: Bool, require unique hostnames.  By default, DigitalOcean allows multiple hosts with the same name.  Setting this to "yes" allows only one host per name.  Useful for idempotence.

options.name: user_data
options.description: opaque blob of data which is made available to the droplet

options.name: virtio
options.description: Bool, turn on virtio driver in droplet for improved network and storage I/O.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the droplet to be in state 'running' before returning.  If wait is "no" an ip_address may not be returned.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
